title: OpenClaw self-healing gateway and agent healthcheck
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';function Get-GatewayOk{$out=& openclaw.cmd gateway status --json 2>&1;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){return $false};try{$j=$out|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json;return ($j.service.runtime.status -eq 'running' -and $j.rpc.ok -eq $true)}catch{return $false}};if(-not(Get-GatewayOk)){Write-Output 'V420_056A_GATEWAY=REPAIR';& openclaw.cmd gateway restart 2>&1|Out-Null;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){& openclaw.cmd gateway stop 2>&1|Out-Null;& openclaw.cmd gateway start 2>&1|Out-Null};$ok=$false;for($i=0;$i -lt 15;$i++){Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;if(Get-GatewayOk){$ok=$true;break}};if(-not $ok){throw 'GATEWAY_SELFHEAL_FAILED'}}else{Write-Output 'V420_056A_GATEWAY=HEALTHY'};$so=Join-Path $root '056a-agent.json';$se=Join-Path $root '056a-agent.err.txt';Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$out=& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key '3en-056a' --message 'Reply with exactly OPENCLAW_SELFHEAL_OK' --json --timeout 180 2>$se;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;$out|Set-Content $so -Encoding UTF8;if($code -ne 0){throw ('AGENT_HEALTHCHECK_FAILED code='+$code)};$raw=Get-Content $so -Raw;$null=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($raw -notmatch 'OPENCLAW_SELFHEAL_OK'){throw 'AGENT_HEALTHCHECK_MARKER_MISSING'};Write-Output 'V420_056A_AGENT=PASS'
